# Install

Extract the zip into your CRC3D3 game root, so that the file ends up at:

```
CRC3D3/BepInEx/plugins/CRC3D3.NotEnoughTranslator.Plugin.dll
```

Requirements: BepInEx 5.x. Nothing else has to be installed alongside it.

# Usage

See the [README](https://github.com/{{REPO}}/blob/main/README.md) for the full documentation, and the translation guide under `Document/` for the CSV / JSONL formats and regex rules.
